characterization_tests.name: test_workspace_switch_concurrent
characterization_tests.description: Simultaneous workspace switches should be serialized
characterization_tests.expected_behavior: Only one transition executes, others wait or return early

characterization_tests.name: test_workspace_switch_partial_failure
characterization_tests.description: If agent re-selection fails mid-transition, workspace should revert
characterization_tests.expected_behavior: Workspace state restored to previous value, error propagated
characterization_tests.test_code: transitionTo('notes') with no agents available - should revert and throw

characterization_tests.name: test_event_listener_error_isolation
characterization_tests.description: One throwing event listener should not crash other listeners or the event bus
characterization_tests.expected_behavior: Throwing listener error is caught, other listeners still execute
characterization_tests.test_code: Emit event with one good and one throwing listener - good listener should still fire

characterization_tests.name: test_dual_write_rollback
characterization_tests.description: If WebContainer write fails after Local FS write, Local FS should be rolled back
characterization_tests.expected_behavior: Local FS file deleted or marked inconsistent after failed dual write
characterization_tests.test_code: writeFile when WebContainer is unavailable - Local FS should not have orphaned file

characterization_tests.name: test_batch_write_rollback_comprehensive
characterization_tests.description: writeMultiple rollback should restore pre-existing files, not just delete
characterization_tests.expected_behavior: Files that existed before batch write are restored with original content
characterization_tests.test_code: writeMultiple to overwrite existing files, then fail mid-way - originals should be restored

characterization_tests.name: test_sync_idempotency
characterization_tests.description: Calling sync multiple times should not cause duplicate operations
characterization_tests.expected_behavior: Subsequent sync calls should be queued or debounced, not throw
characterization_tests.test_code: await sync(); await sync(); await sync(); // Should not throw

characterization_tests.name: test_transition_timeout_cleanup
characterization_tests.description: Rapid workspace switches should not leave stale timeouts
characterization_tests.expected_behavior: Each transition has its own timeout that is properly cleaned up
characterization_tests.test_code: Switch workspaces 10 times rapidly - isTransitioning should eventually be false

characterization_tests.name: test_note_idempotent_save
characterization_tests.description: Calling save on same note multiple times should not cause issues
characterization_tests.expected_behavior: Each save completes, no duplicate work or errors
characterization_tests.test_code: await saveNoteToFile(id); await saveNoteToFile(id); // Both should succeed

characterization_tests.name: test_hardcoded_api_keys_removed
characterization_tests.description: No hardcoded API keys should exist in source code
characterization_tests.expected_behavior: grep for API key patterns should return no matches in src/

characterization_tests.name: test_eval_usage_eliminated
characterization_tests.description: No eval() or new Function() calls should exist in production code
characterization_tests.expected_behavior: grep for eval patterns should return no matches
